in_sanskrit.name: और्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Aurya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘और्य’ (aurya), which means strength, power, energy, heroism, victory. It is a masculine name, often given to baby boys in Hindu culture. The name signifies the inherent strength and power within an individual, and is believed to bring success, triumph, and courage.
